recipe.subject: The reference image shows the stick of dynamite to draw: keep its shape, parts and colours. A single stick of red dynamite: a smooth bright red paper cylinder with two thin dark rings near each end and flat cream paper ends, a pale grey cord fuse curling out of its top end with a charred black tip, wrapped round and round in dark iron barbed wire: one thick strand of dark wire coiling along the stick from end to end, with sharp pointed steel barbs sticking out of the wire all round it, the fuse lit: a big bright yellow and orange spark burst fizzing at its tip with a few tiny sparks flying off, easy to see, plain paper with no letters, numbers or writing anywhere on it, lying diagonally
